children: MAITLAND, ON, Sept. 1, 2026 /CNW/ -- Responsible Energy Corporation (TSXV: REH) ("
") is pleased to announce that the TSX Venture Exchange (the "
") has issued its final bulletin following completion of the Company's Qualifying Transaction with Responsible Energy Inc. ("
The Company's common shares will commence trading on the TSXV under the symbol "REH" effective at the opening of trading on September 2, 2026.
The Qualifying Transaction closed on August 25, 2026, resulting in REI becoming a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company.

Gordon Fraser, President and Chief Executive Officer, said: "After nearly two decades of building Responsible Energy, seeing REH begin trading on the TSX Venture Exchange is a proud moment for me and for everyone who has been part of this journey. A tremendous amount of work, perseverance and belief has brought us to this point. I'm incredibly grateful to our team and shareholders who have believed in what we were building, and excited about what comes next."

Further to the press release of the Company dated August 26, 2026 issued in connection with the Closing of the Qualifying Transaction, the Company notes that a finder's fee of $9,900 was paid in connection with the AD4 Concurrent Financing (as defined in such press release).

Responsible Energy Corporation is a Canadian clean technology company commercializing its patented Free Radical Gasification (FRG™) platform for the destruction of PFAS, AFFF, and other hazardous liquid waste streams. Supported by 10 issued patents, the Company is advancing FRG™ through independent validation toward commercial deployment.
